origin: Original Span artwork, created for the user-requested document view controls.
design: Shared 24-unit viewBox, rounded 19-unit frame and 1.5-unit stroke matching the existing custom split-editor control. Source combines a filled side panel and code chevrons; Preview shows rendered page content; Both combines source and rendered panes.
rendering: Theme-neutral currentColor artwork rendered through the existing Icon alpha mask.
preservation: The earlier supplied markdown-source.svg, markdown-preview.svg and markdown-both.svg remain unchanged with their original provenance, but are no longer used by SourcePreviewToggle.
